name: Login form
summary: Email + password sign-in with remember-me, forgot-password link and error handling. The default pattern for authenticating returning users.

anatomy.purpose: Names the action, e.g. 'Sign in'. First element in the form's accessible name.
type=email with autocomplete=email and a visible label.
type=password with show/hide toggle and autocomplete=current-password.
Checkbox, default off on shared-device contexts.
Full-width primary button, disabled only while submitting.
One message for failed attempts; per-field errors inline. Never reveals whether the email exists.

variants.name: With SSO options
variants.use: Organizations with SAML/OIDC or social login.

contentLimits.sso-buttons: at most 3, with text labels, not logos alone

whenToUse: Gate for content that requires an account.
whenNotToUse: First-time account creation: use a separate sign-up flow.
One-time or magic-link only products: use a single email field.
High-security re-auth for a single action: use a step-up prompt.

accessibility.role: form with aria-labelledby pointing at the heading
keyboard: Tab order: email, password, show/hide toggle, remember-me, submit, secondary links.
On failed login, focus moves to the error summary; it is a role=alert region.
accessibility.focus: Visible focus (2px outline, 3:1 contrast) on every field, toggle, checkbox and link. Autofocus to the email field only when the form is the page.
notes: Never reveal whether the account exists: use 'Email or password is incorrect'.
Labels must be visible; placeholders are not labels.
Use autocomplete=current-password so password managers work.
Error text must meet 4.5:1 on the form background.
